articles.summary: Developers increasingly rely on AI-powered tools like Cursor, Windsurf, and Claude Code to streamline coding, debugging, and automation. But if you want your product to integrate smoothly into these AI-driven workflows, you need to structure your documentation in a way that's optimized for Large Language Models (LLMs).
articles.title: Writing Docs for AI: Making Your Product Seamless for Cursor, Windsurf, and Claude Code Users
